Privacy Policy

Last updated: 29 October 2026

On this page

VK Sports (“we”, “us”) respects your privacy. This policy explains what information we handle when you use this website and order from us, and how we look after it.

What this website collects

You can browse this website without creating an account or giving us any personal details.

  • No accounts, no tracking: the website does not use analytics, advertising trackers or marketing cookies.
  • Your order bag is saved only in your own browser (local storage) so it's still there when you come back. It never reaches us unless you choose to send your order on WhatsApp. You can clear it at any time from the bag.
  • Forms on this site (custom quote, contact) do not send anything to us directly. They open WhatsApp or your email app with your message filled in, and nothing is sent until you press send there.

Information you share when ordering

When you contact us on WhatsApp, by phone or email, we receive the details you choose to share, such as:

  • your name, phone number and WhatsApp profile,
  • delivery address and pincode,
  • order details — products, sizes, quantities, and any names, numbers or logos for printing,
  • payment confirmation details (for example a UPI transaction reference). We never ask for your card details, PIN or OTP.

How we use your information

  • To confirm, produce, pack and deliver your order.
  • To reply to your questions and provide support, exchanges and refunds.
  • To send product updates and offers — only if you've asked to join our updates list. You can opt out any time by replying “STOP”.
  • To keep records required by law, such as invoices and tax records.

Who we share it with

We do not sell or rent your personal information. We only share what's needed with:

  • Courier partners — your name, address and phone number, to deliver your parcel.
  • Payment providers and banks — to process and verify payments.
  • Authorities — when required by law.

Third-party services on this site

Some parts of this website are loaded from other providers, who may receive your IP address and browser information when the page loads:

  • Google Fonts (typography) and Tailwind CSS CDN (page styling).
  • Google Maps — the map on our Contact page.
  • WhatsApp (Meta) — when you tap a WhatsApp button, your conversation is subject to WhatsApp's own privacy policy.

How long we keep it

We keep order information for as long as needed to fulfil your order, handle exchanges and meet legal and tax obligations. Artwork and player lists for custom orders are kept so you can easily re-order; ask us any time to delete them.

Your choices and rights

You can ask us to show, correct or delete the personal information we hold about you, or to stop sending you updates. Under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 you may also withdraw consent and raise a grievance with us.

Keeping it safe

We limit access to your information to the people who need it to serve you, and we take reasonable steps to protect it. No method of storage or transmission is 100% secure, but we work to keep your data safe.

Children

Orders for school and junior teams are placed by parents, teachers or coaches. We don't knowingly collect personal information directly from children.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The “Last updated” date at the top shows when it last changed.

Contact us

For any privacy question or request, email or message us on WhatsApp. Postal address: .
